selector.rationale: Neutrophilic panniculitis is supported by the skin biopsy showing a dense acute neutrophilic infiltrate extending into adipose tissue and septa, and a previous biopsy also revealed neutrophilic panniculitis.

rejected.label: Azathioprine-induced vasculitis
rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence for vasculitis and negative direct immunofluorescence

rejected.label: Ulcerative colitis flare
rejected.why: While the patient has ulcerative colitis, the current symptoms and biopsy findings do not directly support a flare

rejected.label: Autoimmune vasculitis
rejected.why: Negative direct immunofluorescence and lack of specific evidence for autoimmune vasculitis

rejected.label: Sickle cell crisis
rejected.why: Although the patient has sickle cell disease and some symptoms could be consistent with a crisis, the biopsy findings and other evidence better support neutrophilic panniculitis
